advice.en: 🚨 CRITICAL VIRAL INFECTION (No direct cure). Isolate sick birds IMMEDIATELY and call a veterinarian today. Prevent by VACCINATING at Day 1 (ND-HB1 eye drop) and Day 21 (LaSota in unchlorinated water). Provide electrolytes and multivitamins to support uninfected birds. Safely bury or burn dead birds. Local remedy: Soaked cut Tagiri (Christmas melon) or bitter leaf water can be used for general immune prevention in healthy flocks, but NEVER replaces vaccination or cures actively infected birds.
advice.ha: 🚨 CUTAR VIRUS MAI TSANANI (Babu maganin warkewa kai tsaye). Ware tsuntsaye marasa lafiya YANZU kuma kira likitan dabbobi yau. YI RIGAKAFI a Rana 1 (a ido da ND-HB1) da Rana 21 (LaSota a ruwa mara sinadarin chlorine). Ba da ruwan electrolytes da bitamin don taimaka wa sauran tsuntsayen. Binne ko ƙone matattun kaji cikin aminci. Maganin gargajiya: Za a iya jika yankakken Tagiri ko ruwan Shuwaka a ruwan sha don rigakafin garkuwar jiki, amma KADA a ɗauke shi a matsayin madadin rigakafi ko maganin tsuntsu mai ciwo.
advice.yo: 🚨 ÀRÙN FÁÍRỌ́Ọ̀SÌ LÁGBÁRA (Kò sí oògùn àwòtán tààràtà). Ya àwọn adìẹ aláìsàn sọ́tọ̀ LẸ́SẸ̀KẸSẸ̀ kí o sì pe dókítà ẹran lónìí. Dènà rẹ̀ nípa ṢÍṢE AJESARA ní Ọjọ́ kìíní (oju pẹlu ND-HB1) àti Ọjọ́ 21 (LaSota nínú omi tí kò ní chlorine). Fún wọn ní electrolytes àti àwọn èròjà vitamin láti ran àwọn tókù lọ́wọ́. Sin tàbí dáná sun àwọn adìẹ tó kú láìséwu. Oògùn ìbílẹ̀: Omi Tagiri tàbí ewúrò tí a rẹ sínú omi lè ṣèrànwọ́ fún ààbò ara nínú adìẹ tó dára, ṣùgbọ́n KÒ LÈ dípò ajesara tàbí wo adìẹ tó ti ní àrùn sàn.
advice.ig: 🚨 ỌRỊA VIRUS DỊ EGWU (Enweghị ọgwụgwọ ozugbo). Kewapụ ọkụkọ na-arịa ọrịa OZIGBO ma kpọọ dibia anụmanụ taa. Gbochie ya site na ịgba ỌGWỤ MGBOCHI n'Ụbọchị 1 (anya na ND-HB1) na Ụbọchị 21 (LaSota na mmiri na-enweghị chlorine). Nye electrolytes na vitamin iji kwado ndị ahụ siri ike. Lie ma ọ bụ kpọọ ọkụkọ nwụrụ anwụ ọkụ. Ọgwụ ọdịnala: Enwere ike iji Tagiri ma ọ bụ mmiri Onugbu mee ka ahụ ha sie ike maka mgbochi, mana ọ BỤGHỊ ihe dochie anya ọgwụ mgbochi.
advice.pcm: 🚨 CRITICAL VIRUS OUTBREAK (No direct cure). Separate sick birds NOW NOW and call vet doctor today. Prevent am by GIVING VACCINE for Day 1 (ND-HB1 eye drop) and Day 21 (LaSota inside water wey no get chlorine). Give electrolytes and multivitamins to support remaining healthy birds. Bury or burn dead birds safely. Local remedy: Soaked Tagiri (Christmas melon) or bitter leaf water fit help build body defense before sickness come, but e NO FIT replace vaccine or cure bird wey don already catch virus.
advice.sw: 🚨 UGONJWA HATARI WA VIRUSI (Hauna tiba ya moja kwa moja). Tenga ndege wagonjwa MARA MOJA na umpigie daktari wa mifugo leo. Zuia kwa KUCHANJA Siku ya 1 (tone la jicho la ND-HB1) na Siku ya 21 (LaSota kwenye maji yasiyo na klorini). Wape ndege waliobaki maji yenye madini joto (electrolytes) na vitamini. Fikia au choma mizoga ya kuku kwa usalama. Tiba ya kienyeji: Maji ya Tagiri au majani machungu yanaweza kutumika kama kinga ya kawaida, lakini HAYATIBU ugonjwa uliopo wala kuchukua nafasi ya chanjo.

advice.en: 🚨 STATUTORY EMERGENCY / ZOONOTIC (Transmissible to humans). DO NOT touch or consume sick or dead birds. Immediately report the outbreak to the nearest Ministry of Agriculture or Government Veterinary Officer. Isolate the entire farm, restrict human/vehicle movement, and enforce strict biosecurity. No farm medication or herbal remedy is permitted or effective for Bird Flu.
advice.ha: 🚨 GAGGAWA TA DOKA / CUTAR DA KE SHAFAR DAN ADAM. KADA ka taɓa ko cin naman tsuntsaye marasa lafiya ko matattu. Kai rahoton ɓarkewar cutar cikin gaggawa ga Ma'aikatar Aikin Gona ko Likitan Dabbobi na Gwamnati mafi kusa. Kulle gidan gonar, hana zirga-zirgar mutane ko motoci, kuma bi tsauraran matakan tsaro. Babu wani magani ko maganin gargajiya da aka amince da shi ko yake da amfani ga Murar Tsuntsaye.
advice.yo: 🚨 ÌKÌLỌ̀ PÀJÁWÌRÌ / ÀRÙN TÓ LÈ RAN ÈNÌYÀN. MÁ ṢE fọwọ́ kan tàbí jẹ ẹyẹ aláìsàn tàbí òkú. Jábọ̀ fún Ilé-Iṣẹ́ Iṣẹ́ Àgbẹ̀ tàbí Dókítà Ẹran Ìjọba tó súnmọ́ ọ lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀. Ti gbogbo oko náà pa, dáwọ́ ìrìn-àjò ènìyàn/ọkọ̀ dúró, kí o sì mú ìṣọ́ra le. Kò sí oògùn ilé-iṣẹ́ tàbí oògùn ìbílẹ̀ kankan tí a fàyègbà fún Bird Flu.
advice.ig: 🚨 MKPỌTỤRỤ NDỊ ỌCHỊCHỊ / ỌRỊA NA-EFE MMADỤ. EMETỤLA ma ọ bụ rie nnụnụ na-arịa ọrịa ma ọ bụ nwụrụ anwụ. Kpọtụrụ Ministri Ọrụ Ugbo ma ọ bụ Dibia Anụmanụ nke Gọọmentị kacha nso ozugbo. Mechie ugbo ahụ dum, ma mee ka nchekwa sie ike. Enweghị ọgwụ ụlọ ahịa ma ọ bụ ọgwụ ọdịnala ọ bụla kwere omume maka Bird Flu.
advice.pcm: 🚨 GOVERNMENT EMERGENCY / SICKNESS FIT CATCH HUMAN. NO TOUCH and NO CHOP sick or dead birds! Report sharp sharp to nearest Ministry of Agriculture or Government Vet Doctor. Block anybody from entering the farm, wash everything with strong disinfectant. No medicine or local herb dey work for Bird Flu, only government vet fit handle am.
advice.sw: 🚨 DHARURA YA KISHERIA / HUAMBUKIZA BINADAMU. USIGUSE wala kula kuku wagonjwa au waliokufa. Toa taarifa mara moja kwa Wizara ya Kilimo au Afisa Mifugo wa Serikali aliye karibu. Weka karantini shamba zima na uzuie watu kuingia. Hakuna dawa ya duka wala ya kienyeji inayoruhusiwa au kufanya kazi kwa Mafua ya Ndege.

advice.en: Buy AMPROLIUM from a vet shop and follow the exact dosage on the packet label based on concentration (medicated water must be their ONLY drinking water for 5-7 days). ⚠️ Do NOT mix with Vitamin B supplements during treatment. Keep litter/bedding completely dry. Local remedy: Bitter leaf (Vernonia amygdalina) or Aloe Vera can be given for gut recovery AFTER medication ends, never mixed into medicated water.
advice.ha: Sayi AMPROLIUM daga shagon likitan dabbobi kuma ka bi ainihin adadin da aka rubuta a jikin fakitin (ruwan magani ya zama KAWAI ruwan shansu na kwanaki 5-7). ⚠️ Kada a hada da sinadarin Vitamin B lokacin jinya. Tabbatar shimfidar kaji ta bushe sarai. Maganin gargajiya: Za a iya ba da Shuwaka ko Aloe Vera don farfado da hanji BAYAN an gama maganin, amma kada a gauraya su a cikin ruwan magani.
advice.yo: Ra AMPROLIUM láti ilé ìtajà oògùn kí o sì tẹ̀lé ìwọ̀n tó wà lórí páálí náà (omi oògùn náà gbọ́dọ̀ jẹ́ OMI KANṢOṢO tí wọ́n ń mu fún ọjọ́ 5-7). ⚠️ Má ṣe fún wọn ní Vitamin B lásìkò ìtọ́jú yìí. Rí i dájú pé ibùsùn wọn gbẹ pátápátá. Oògùn ìbílẹ̀: O lè lo ewúrò tàbí Aloe Vera fún ìmúbọ̀sípò LẸ́YÌN tí o bá parí oògùn náà, má ṣe pò ó pọ̀ mọ́ omi oògùn.
advice.ig: Zụta AMPROLIUM n'ụlọ ahịa ọgwụ ma soro usoro ọgwụgwọ dị na ngwugwu ya (mmiri ọgwụ a ga-abụ naanị mmiri ha ga-aṅụ maka ụbọchị 5-7). ⚠️ Ejikọtala ya na Vitamin B n'oge ọgwụgwọ. Debe ebe obibi ha ka ọ kọọ nke ọma. Ọgwụ ọdịnala: Enwere ike iji Onugbu ma ọ bụ Aloe Vera mee ka afọ ha dị mma MGBE agwụchara ọgwụ a, ejikwala ya gwakọta mmiri ọgwụ.
advice.pcm: Buy AMPROLIUM from vet shop and follow the exact dosage wey dey the packet (the medicated water must be dia ONLY drinking water for 5-7 days). ⚠️ NO mix Vitamin B supplements inside during treatment. Keep the floor/bedding dry well well. Local remedy: You fit give Bitter leaf or Aloe Vera to help dia belle recover AFTER the medicine finishes, no mix am inside the medicated water.
advice.sw: Nunua AMPROLIUM kutoka duka la mifugo na ufuate maelekezo ya kipimo kwenye pakiti (maji ya dawa yawe maji yao PEKEE ya kunywa kwa siku 5-7). ⚠️ Usichanganye na Vitamin B wakati wa matibabu. Weka matandiko makavu. Tiba ya kienyeji: Tumia Aloe Vera kusaidia tumbo BAADA ya kumaliza dawa, usichanganye ndani ya maji ya dawa.

advice.en: 🚨 HIGH SEVERITY VIRAL INFECTION (Attacks immune bursa). Provide supportive care immediately: give clean water with electrolytes, glucose, and kidney-flushing supplements to prevent dehydration and kidney failure. Do NOT give heavy antibiotics that stress the kidneys unless prescribed by a vet. Prevent future outbreaks by strictly vaccinating at Day 10 and Day 21 (Gumboro vaccine in cold, unchlorinated water). Local remedy: Bitter leaf or garlic water can be given for immune recovery AFTER the crisis, never mixed with medications.
advice.ha: 🚨 CUTAR VIRUS MAI TSANANI (Tana lalata garkuwar jiki da ƙoda). Ba da tallafin gaggawa: ba da tsaftataccen ruwa mai ɗauke da electrolytes, glucose, da sinadarin wanke ƙoda don hana bushewar ruwan jiki da gazawar ƙoda. KADA ka ba da magungunan kashe ƙwayoyin cuta (antibiotics) masu nauyi ba tare da izinin likita ba. Yi rigakafin ɓarkewa ta hanyar yin rigakafin Gumboro a Rana 10 da Rana 21 a ruwa mai sanyi mara chlorine. Maganin gargajiya: Za a iya ba da ruwan Shuwaka ko tafarnuwa bayan tsuntsaye sun fara samun sauƙi.
advice.yo: 🚨 ÀRÙN FÁÍRỌ́Ọ̀SÌ LÁGBÁRA (Ó ń ba ààbò ara àti kíndìnrín jẹ́). Pèsè ìtọ́jú ìrànwọ́ lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀: fún wọn ní omi mímọ́ tó ní electrolytes, glucose, àti àwọn èròjà fún kíndìnrín láti dènà gbígbẹ omi ara. MÁ ṢE fún wọn ní antibiotics líle láìsí àṣẹ dókítà. Dènà rẹ̀ nípa ṣíṣe àjẹsára Gumboro ní Ọjọ́ 10 àti Ọjọ́ 21 nínú omi tútù tí kò ní chlorine. Oògùn ìbílẹ̀: O lè lo omi ewúrò tàbí àlùbọ́sà funfun (garlic) fún ìmúbọ̀sípò LẸ́YÌN tí àrùn náà bá ti rọlẹ̀.
advice.ig: 🚨 ỌRỊA VIRUS DỊ EGWU (Na-emebi usoro nchekwa ahụ na akụrụ). Nye nlekọta nkwado ozugbo: nye mmiri dị ọcha nwere electrolytes, glucose na ihe na-asachapụ akụrụ iji gbochie akpịrị ịkpọ nkụ. ENYELA ọgwụ antibiotics siri ike n'ejighị ndụmọdụ dibia anụmanụ. Gbochie ya site na ịgba ọgwụ mgbochi Gumboro n'Ụbọchị 10 na Ụbọchị 21 na mmiri oyi na-enweghị chlorine. Ọgwụ ọdịnala: Enwere ike iji Onugbu ma ọ bụ garlic mee ka ahụ ha dị mma MGBE nsogbu ahụ gasịrị.
advice.pcm: 🚨 SERIOUS VIRUS SICKNESS (E dey destroy body defense and kidney). Give support treatment immediately: mix clean water with electrolytes, glucose, and kidney-flushing tonic make dem no dehydrate. NO GIVE heavy antibiotics wey go overwork dia kidney unless vet doctor talk so. Prevent am for future by VACCINATING at Day 10 and Day 21 (Gumboro vaccine in cold water without chlorine). Local remedy: Bitter leaf or garlic water fit support dia immunity AFTER the crisis don pass, no mix am with medicines.
advice.sw: 🚨 MAAMBUKIZI MAKALI YA VIRUSI (Hushambulia kinga ya mwili na figo). Toa huduma ya msaada mara moja: wape maji safi yenye electrolytes, glucose, na dawa ya kusafisha figo ili kuzuia upungufu wa maji mwilini. USIWAPE antibiotics nzito bila ushauri wa daktari. Zuia kwa KUCHANJA Siku ya 10 na Siku ya 21 (chanjo ya Gumboro kwenye maji baridi yasiyo na klorini). Tiba ya kienyeji: Majani machungu au kitunguu saumu vinaweza kusaidia kurejesha nguvu BAADA ya hali kutulia.

advice.en: 🚨 CRITICAL ONCOGENIC VIRUS (Causes nerve tumors and one-leg paralysis). There is NO effective cure once paralysis appears. Humanely cull severely paralyzed birds to stop infectious feather dander shedding. Prevent in future flocks by ensuring day-old chicks are VACCINATED at the hatchery on Day 1. Thoroughly disinfect pens and manage dust. Local remedy: No herbal remedy cures Marek's disease; strict hatchery vaccination is the only solution.
advice.ha: 🚨 CUTAR VIRUS MAI LALATA JINI DA JANYE ƘAFA. Babu maganin warkewa da zarar an ga tsuntsu ya janye ƙafa ɗaya ko ya shanye. Ware ko kashe tsuntsayen da suka shanye cikin aminci don hana yaɗuwar cutar ta ƙurar gashinsu. Yi rigakafi a nan gaba ta hanyar tabbatar an yi wa ƴan tsakin da aka kyankyashe RIGAKAFI a ranar farko (Day 1). Maganin gargajiya: Babu maganin gargajiya da ke warkar da Marek's; rigakafin rana ta farko ce kaɗai hanyar magance ta.
advice.yo: 🚨 ÀRÙN FÁÍRỌ́Ọ̀SÌ TÓ Ń FA RÍRO ẸSẸ̀ ÀTI AKRẸN (Marek's). Kò sí oògùn àwòtán kankan nígbà tí ẹsẹ̀ bá ti rọ. Yọ àwọn adìẹ tí ẹsẹ̀ wọn rọ kúrò láti dènà ìtànkálẹ̀ nípasẹ̀ ìyẹ́ wọn. Dènà rẹ̀ fún àwọn adìẹ tuntun nípa rírí i dájú pé a ṢE AJESARA fún àwọn ọmọ adìẹ ní ọjọ́ kìíní ní ibi ìyéyin (hatchery). Oògùn ìbílẹ̀: Kò sí oògùn ìbílẹ̀ tó ń wo Marek's sàn; ajesara ọjọ́ kìíní nìkan ni ojútùú.
advice.ig: 🚨 ỌRỊA VIRUS NA-AKPATA NKWỤSỊ ỤKWỤ (Marek's). Enweghị ọgwụgwọ ọ bụla ozugbo ụkwụ kpọrọ nkụ. Kewapụ ma wepụ ọkụkọ ndị ahụ kpọnwụrụ akpọnwụ iji gbochie mgbasa ya site n'ákwà ábụbà ha. Gbochie ya n'ọdịnihu site n'ịhụ na agbara ụmụ ọkụkọ ọhụrụ ỌGWỤ MGBOCHI n'Ụbọchị 1 n'ụlọ nkwụnye akwa. Ọgwụ ọdịnala: Enweghị ọgwụ ọdịnala na-agwọ Marek's; naanị ọgwụ mgbochi ụbọchị mbụ na-egbochi ya.
advice.pcm: 🚨 DANGEROUS VIRUS SICKNESS (E dey paralyze one leg and form tumors). No cure dey once leg don paralyze. Separate and cull birds wey don paralyze so dem no go spread infection through dia feathers dust. Prevent am for your next set of birds by making sure day-old chicks get VACCINE for Day 1 inside hatchery. Disinfect pen well well. Local remedy: No local herb fit cure Marek's disease; only Day 1 hatchery vaccine fit prevent am.
advice.sw: 🚨 MAAMBUKIZI YA VIRUSI YANAYOSABABISHA KUPOOZA KWA MIGUU (Marek's). Hakuna tiba mara tu ndege anapopooza. Waondoe ndege waliopooza ili kuzuia kueneza ugonjwa kupitia manyoya na vumbi. Zuia kwa kuhakikisha vifaranga wanapata CHANJO Siku ya 1 wakiwa kiwandani (hatchery). Safisha mabanda vizuri. Tiba ya kienyeji: Hakuna dawa ya asili inayotibu Marek's; chanjo ya siku ya kwanza ndiyo njia pekee.

advice.en: Poxvirus infection. Treatment is supportive: gently clean external skin scabs with mild iodine or dilute gentian violet; do NOT forcefully pull off wet scabs inside the mouth. Administer water-soluble multivitamins (Vitamins A and E) to boost skin repair, and broad-spectrum antibiotics if secondary bacterial infections occur (follow label dosage; exclusive water for 5 days). Prevent with FOWL POX VACCINE (wing-web stab) at 6-8 weeks. Local remedy: Apply virgin palm oil mixed with clean wood ash or neem oil directly onto dry external scabs to soothe and dry them up.
advice.ha: Cutar Fowl Pox (Ƙwayoyin ƙuraje a fatar kai ko baki). Taimakon jinya: A wanke ƙurajen fatar kai a hankali da iodine ko gentian violet; KADA a ɓare ƙurajen cikin baki da ƙarfi. Ba da sinadarin bitamin (Vitamins A da E) a cikin ruwa don warkar da fata, da maganin antibiotics idan ƙwayoyin cuta sun shiga (bi ƙa'idar fakiti na kwanaki 5 a matsayin KAWAI ruwan shansu). Yi RIGAKAFIN FOWL POX (ta fuka-fuki) a mako 6-8. Maganin gargajiya: A shafa man ja mai kyau da tokar itace ko man maina a jikin ƙurajen waje don busar da su.
advice.yo: Àrùn Èépú Adìẹ (Fowl Pox). Ìtọ́jú: Fọ àwọn eépú ojú àwọ̀ pẹ̀lẹ́pẹ̀lẹ́ pẹ̀lú iodine tàbí gentian violet; MÁ ṢE já àwọn eépú inú ẹnu pẹ̀lú ipá. Fún wọn ní multivitamin (Vitamin A àti E) nínú omi láti ran àwọ̀ wọn lọ́wọ́, àti antibiotics tí àkóràn mìíràn bá wọ̀ ọ́ (tẹ̀lé ìlànà páálí fún ọjọ́ 5 gẹ́gẹ́ bí OMI KANṢOṢO tí wọ́n ń mu). Dènà rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú AJESARA FOWL POX ní ọ̀sẹ̀ 6-8. Oògùn ìbílẹ̀: Para epo pupa tí a da eérú igi mọ́ sí orí àwọn eépú ìta láti mú kí wọ́n gbẹ kíákíá.
advice.ig: Ọrịa Fowl Pox (Akpụ n'ahụ na ọnụ). Ọgwụgwọ nkwado: Jiri iodine ma ọ bụ gentian violet hichaa akpụ dị n'èzí nwayọọ; ADỌPỤLA akpụ dị n'ime ọnụ n'ike. Nye multivitamins (Vitamin A na E) na mmiri maka imezi anụ ahụ, na antibiotics ma ọ bụrụ na nje ọzọ abata (soro ntuziaka ngwugwu maka ụbọchị 5 dị ka NAANỊ mmiri ọñụñụ ha). Gbochie ya site n'ịgba ỌGWỤ MGBOCHI FOWL POX n'izuụka 6-8. Ọgwụ ọdịnala: Tee mmanụ nri na ntụ ọkụ n'elu akpụ ndị dị n'èzí iji mee ka ha kọọ ngwa ngwa.
advice.pcm: Fowl Pox virus (Pox pimples on face or inside mouth). Treatment: Gently clean outside scabs with dilute iodine or gentian violet; NO FORCEFULLY PEEL scabs inside mouth. Put multivitamins (Vitamin A and E) inside dia water to heal skin, and give antibiotics if secondary bacteria enter (follow packet label dosage as dia ONLY drinking water for 5 days). Prevent with FOWL POX VACCINE (wing-web puncture) at 6-8 weeks. Local remedy: Rub clean palm oil mixed with wood ash or neem oil directly on outside skin scabs to dry them up fast.
advice.sw: Maambukizi ya Ndui ya Kuku (Fowl Pox). Huduma: Safisha vidonda vya nje kwa iodini hafifu au gentian violet; USIKUNYUE vidonda vya ndani ya mdomo kwa nguvu. Wape vitamini mchanganyiko (A na E) kwenye maji kusaidia ngozi kupona, na antibiotics kama kuna maambukizi ya ziada (fuata kipimo cha pakiti kwa siku 5 kama maji yao PEKEE). Zuia kwa CHANJO YA NDUI kwenye bawa wiki ya 6-8. Tiba ya kienyeji: Paka mafuta ya mawese yaliyochanganywa na majivu safi kwenye vidonda vya nje ili vikaushe.

advice.en: Contagious respiratory coronavirus. Increase brooder temperature/warmth and improve coop ventilation without drafts. Provide electrolytes and multivitamins in clean drinking water. If secondary bacterial CRD develops (loud rattling/snicking), administer veterinary antibiotics like TYLOSIN or DOXYCYCLINE according to packet label instructions (medicated water as their ONLY drinking water for 5 days). Prevent by VACCINATING at Day 1 (IB-H120 eye drop/spray) and boosting at Week 3. Local remedy: Squeezed ginger and garlic warm water infusion can be given as a supportive respiratory booster, never mixed into medicated water.
advice.ha: Cutar Numfashi ta IB (Kwayar cutar Coronavirus). Ƙara ɗumin ɗaki kuma tabbatar da isasshen iska mai kyau. Ba da electrolytes da multivitamins a cikin ruwan sha mai tsafta. Idan cutar ta haifar da tari mai ƙarfi da kwayoyin cuta suka shiga, ba da TYLOSIN ko DOXYCYCLINE bisa ƙa'idar fakiti (ruwan magani ya zama KAWAI ruwan shansu na kwanaki 5). Yi RIGAKAFI a Rana 1 (IB-H120 a ido) da kuma maimaitawa a Mako 3. Maganin gargajiya: Za a iya ba da ruwan citta da tafarnuwa a matsayin mai buɗe hanyar numfashi, amma kada a gauraya a cikin ruwan magani.
advice.yo: Àrùn Ẹ̀dọ̀fóró Adìẹ (Infectious Bronchitis). Mú kí ibùgbé wọn gbóná kí o sì rí i dájú pé afẹ́fẹ́ mímọ́ ń wọlé dáadáa. Fún wọn ní electrolytes àti multivitamins nínú omi mímọ́. advice.pcm: Infectious Bronchitis virus (Respiratory cough and rattling). Make the house warm and ensure good fresh air without breeze blowing directly on chicks. PÀTÀKÌ: Fọ àwọn tanki omi àti koto omi dáadáa; rí i dájú pé omi mímọ́ wà fún wọn tí ìgbẹ́ kò wọ̀. Oògùn ìbílẹ̀: Omi ewúrò lè ran ikùn wọn lọ́wọ́ LẸ́YÌN tí o bá parí oògùn náà tán.
advice.ig: Ọrịa E. coli (Colibacillosis). Jiri ọgwụ antibiotics gwọọ ya: NEOMYCIN, ENROFLOXACIN, ma ọ bụ COLISTIN dịka ntuziaka ngwugwu si dị (mmiri ọgwụ a ga-abụ NAANỊ mmiri ọñụñụ ha maka ụbọchị 5-7). IHE DỊ MKPÀ: Saa tanki mmiri na efere mmiri ha nke ọma; hụ na mmiri ha dị ọcha ma ghara inwe nsị ọkụkọ. Ọgwụ ọdịnala: Enwere ike iji mmiri Onugbu kwado afọ ha MGBE agwụchara ọgwụ a.
advice.pcm: E. coli bacterial infection (Colibacillosis). Treat with vet antibiotics: NEOMYCIN, ENROFLOXACIN, or COLISTIN following exact packet label dosage (medicated water must be dia ONLY drinking water for 5-7 days). VERY IMPORTANT: Wash your water tanks and drinkers well well; make sure drinking water is 100% clean and no chicken poop enter inside. Local remedy: Bitter leaf extract fit help settle dia stomach AFTER finishing antibiotic treatment.
advice.sw: Maambukizi ya Bakteria ya E. coli (Colibacillosis). Tibu kwa antibiotics za mifugo: NEOMYCIN, ENROFLOXACIN, au COLISTIN kulingana na maelekezo ya pakiti (maji ya dawa yawe maji yao PEKEE kwa siku 5-7). MUHIMU: Safisha matangi ya maji na vyombo vya kunywea; hakikisha maji ni safi na hayana kinyesi cha kuku. Tiba ya kienyeji: Majani machungu husaidia kurejesha utumbo katika hali nzuri BAADA ya kumaliza antibiotics.

advice.en: Fungal spore infection (Aspergillus fumigatus Brooder Pneumonia). ⚠️ DO NOT GIVE ANTIBIOTICS (antibiotics worsen fungal growth!). Immediately REMOVE and REPLACE all moldy feed, wet bedding, and damp wood shavings. Thoroughly disinfect the brooder pen with a veterinary antifungal disinfectant (e.g. Copper Sulfate or Virkon S). Provide clean, dry bedding, excellent ventilation, and multivitamin/electrolyte support in clean water. Local remedy: Add organic Apple Cider Vinegar (5ml per 1 liter of drinking water) to acidify the gut and suppress fungal proliferation.
advice.ha: Ciwon Fungi na Aspergillosis (Brooder Pneumonia). ⚠️ KADA KA BA DA ANTIBIOTICS (magungunan kashe kwayoyin cuta suna ƙara yawan fungal!). Cire kuma SAUYA duk wani abinci mai fungi ko shimfida mai danshi nan da nan. Wanke ɗakin da sinadarin kashe fungal (kamar Copper Sulfate). Ba da shimfida mai bushewa, iska mai kyau, da bitamin a ruwa. Maganin gargajiya: Ƙara Apple Cider Vinegar (cokali 1 a litar ruwa 1) a ruwan sha don magance fungal a ciki.
advice.yo: Àrùn Fungi Aspergillosis (Brooder Pneumonia). ⚠️ MÁ ṢE FÚN WỌN NÍ ANTIBIOTICS (oògùn antibiotics ń mú kí fungi pọ̀ sí i!). YỌ gbogbo oúnjẹ tó ní fungus àti ìtẹ́ tó tutù kúrò lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀. Fọ gbogbo ibùgbé wọn pẹ̀lú oògùn tó ń pa fungus (bíi Copper Sulfate). Pèsè ìtẹ́ tó gbẹ, afẹ́fẹ́ tó dára, àti multivitamins nínú omi mímọ́. Oògùn ìbílẹ̀: Fi Apple Cider Vinegar (ìwọ̀n gíláàsì kékeré 5ml sí lita omi kan) sínú omi mímu wọn láti dènà fungi.
advice.ig: Ọrịa Fungi Aspergillosis (Brooder Pneumonia). ⚠️ ENYELA ỌGWỤ ANTIBIOTICS (antibiotics na-eme ka fungi too ngwa ngwa!). Wepụ ma GBANWEE nri niile nwere mold na ihe ndina niile dị mmiri ozugbo. Jiri ọgwụ na-egbu fungi sachaa ụlọ ha. Nye ihe ndina kpọrọ nkụ, ikuku dị mma na multivitamins na mmiri. Ọgwụ ọdịnala: Tinye Apple Cider Vinegar (5ml n'ime lita mmiri 1) n'ime mmiri ọñụñụ ha iji gbochie fungi n'afọ ha.
advice.pcm: Fungal infection from mold (Aspergillus Brooder Pneumonia). ⚠️ NO GIVE ANTIBIOTICS (antibiotics dey make fungus grow worse!). Immediately PACK OUT and CHANGE all moldy feed, wet wood shavings, and damp floor. Disinfect the room with antifungal chemical (like Copper Sulfate or Virkon). Put dry clean wood shavings, open windows for good breeze, and give multivitamins. Local remedy: Mix Apple Cider Vinegar (5ml inside 1 liter of drinking water) to acidify dia belly and stop fungus from spreading.
advice.sw: Maambukizi ya Kuvu / Fangasi (Aspergillosis). ⚠️ USIWAPE ANTIBIOTICS (antibiotics huzidisha ukuaji wa fangasi!). ONDOA na UBADILISHE chakula chenye ukungu na matandiko yenye unyevu mara moja. Safisha banda kwa dawa ya kuua fangasi (kama Copper Sulfate). Weka matandiko makavu, hewa ya kutosha, na vitamini kwenye maji safi. Tiba ya kienyeji: Weka Apple Cider Vinegar (5ml kwa lita 1 ya maji ya kunywa) kusaidia kuzuia fangasi tumboni.

advice.en: Internal parasitic worms (Roundworms, Cecal worms, Tapeworms). Deworm the entire flock with veterinary dewormer: LEVAMISOLE, PIPERAZINE, or ALBENDAZOLE according to the exact packet label instructions (usually given in drinking water for 1 day). CRITICAL: Repeat deworming after 14-21 days to kill newly hatched worms. Keep litter dry and clean to break the worm egg cycle. ⚠️ Observe meat/egg withdrawal period on the packet label. Local remedy: Crushed raw papaya (pawpaw) seeds or pumpkin seeds in feed serve as traditional mild supportive dewormers for backyard flocks.
advice.ha: Tsutsotsin Ciki (Worms). Ba wa dukan garken maganin tsutsotsi na likitan dabbobi: LEVAMISOLE, PIPERAZINE, ko ALBENDAZOLE bisa ƙa'idar da ke jikin fakiti (galibi a ruwan sha na yini 1). ABU MAI AMFANI: Maimaita ba da maganin bayan kwanaki 14-21 don kashe sabbin tsutsotsin da suka ƙyanƙyashe. Tabbatar shimfidar kaji ta bushe sarai. ⚠️ Kula da lokacin hana cin nama/ƙwai da ke kan fakitin. Maganin gargajiya: Za a iya daka ƙwayoyin gwanda ko ƙwayoyin kabewa a haɗa a abinci a matsayin mai korar tsutsotsi na gargajiya.
advice.yo: Àrùn Eesun/Aràn Inú (Internal Parasites). Fún gbogbo agbo adìẹ ní oògùn aràn: LEVAMISOLE, PIPERAZINE, tàbí ALBENDAZOLE gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìlànà páálí oògùn náà (nínú omi fún ọjọ́ kan). PÀTÀKÌ: Tun oògùn náà fún wọn lẹ́yìn ọjọ́ 14-21 láti pa àwọn aràn tuntun tí wọ́n ṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ yé. Jẹ́ kí ibùsùn wọn gbẹ dáadáa. ⚠️ Tẹ̀lé àkókò ìdádúró fún jíjẹ ẹran/ẹyin. Oògùn ìbílẹ̀: Ẹ̀pà ìbílẹ̀ bíi koro ìbépẹ (pawpaw seeds) tàbí koro elégédé tí a lọ mọ́ oúnjẹ lè ṣèrànwọ́ fún dídáwọ́ aràn dúró.
advice.ig: Ọrịa Ụmụ Arụrụ / Ikpuru Afọ (Worms). Nye igwe ọkụkọ niile ọgwụ ikpuru: LEVAMISOLE, PIPERAZINE, ma ọ bụ ALBENDAZOLE dịka ntuziaka ngwugwu si dị (na mmiri maka otu ụbọchị). IHE DỊ MKPÀ: Megharịa ọgwụgwọ a mgbe ụbọchị 14-21 gachara iji gbuo ndị ọhụrụ pụtara n'àkwá. Debe ebe obibi ha ka ọ kọọ nke ọma. ⚠️ Debe oge nchere maka iri anụ/akwa. Ọgwụ ọdịnala: Enwere ike ịkụ mkpụrụ pọpọ ma ọ bụ mkpụrụ ugu n'ime nri ha maka nkwado nchụpụ ikpuru.
advice.pcm: Inside body worms (Roundworms, Tapeworms). Deworm all the birds with vet medicine: LEVAMISOLE, PIPERAZINE, or ALBENDAZOLE following exact packet label dosage (usually mixed inside drinking water for 1 day). VERY IMPORTANT: Repeat deworming after 14-21 days to kill new worms wey just hatch from eggs. Keep floor dry so worm eggs no fit survive. ⚠️ Follow meat/egg withdrawal period on the packet. Local remedy: Grind raw pawpaw seeds or pumpkin seeds into dia feed to support natural deworming for backyard birds.
advice.sw: Minyoo ya Ndani ya Tumbo (Worms). Wape kuku wote dawa ya minyoo ya mifugo: LEVAMISOLE, PIPERAZINE, au ALBENDAZOLE kulingana na maelekezo ya pakiti (kawaida kwenye maji ya kunywa kwa siku 1). MUHIMU: Rudia kutoa dawa baada ya siku 14-21 ili kuua minyoo mipya iliyoanguliwa. Weka matandiko makavu. ⚠️ Zingatia muda wa kusubiri kabla ya kula nyama/mayai. Tiba ya kienyeji: Saga mbegu mbichi za papai au mbegu za maboga kwenye chakula kusaidia kutoa minyoo kiasili.

advice.en: Severe bacterial gut necrosis (Clostridium perfringens). Treat immediately with veterinary antibiotics: AMOXICILLIN, PENICILLIN, or BACITRACIN (Zinc Bacitracin) soluble powder according to the exact packet label instructions (medicated water as their ONLY drinking water for 5-7 days). CRITICAL: Check for and treat underlying Coccidiosis, which damages gut lining and triggers Clostridium outbreaks. Avoid high-viscosity cereal feeds and keep bedding dry. Local remedy: Squeezed bitter leaf or aloe vera water can be given for gut lining recovery AFTER antibiotic treatment ends.
advice.ha: Ciwon Ruɓewar Hanji (Necrotic Enteritis - Clostridium). Yi magani cikin gaggawa da magungunan antibiotics: AMOXICILLIN, PENICILLIN, ko BACITRACIN bisa ƙa'idar fakiti (ruwan magani ya zama KAWAI ruwan shansu na kwanaki 5-7). ABU MAI AMFANI: Bincika kuma ka magance cutar Coccidiosis domin ita ke buɗe wa Clostridium hanya. Tabbatar shimfida ta bushe. Maganin gargajiya: Za a iya ba da ruwan Shuwaka ko Aloe Vera don farfado da hanji BAYAN an gama maganin asibiti.
advice.yo: Àrùn Ìbàjẹ́ Ìfun Adìẹ (Necrotic Enteritis). Tọ́jú rẹ̀ lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀ pẹ̀lú antibiotics: AMOXICILLIN, PENICILLIN, tàbí BACITRACIN gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìlànà páálí oògùn náà (omi oògùn gbọ́dọ̀ jẹ́ OMI KANṢOṢO tí wọ́n ń mu fún ọjọ́ 5-7). PÀTÀKÌ: Ṣayẹwo kí o sì tọ́jú Coccidiosis pẹ̀lú nítorí ó ń ba inú ìfun jẹ́ fún Clostridium láti wọlé. Jẹ́ kí ibùsùn gbẹ. Oògùn ìbílẹ̀: Omi ewúrò tàbí Aloe Vera lè ran ìfun lọ́wọ́ láti bọ̀sípò LẸ́YÌN tí o bá parí oògùn náà tán.
advice.ig: Ọrịa Mmebi Afọ (Necrotic Enteritis). Jiri ọgwụ antibiotics gwọọ ya ozugbo: AMOXICILLIN, PENICILLIN, ma ọ bụ BACITRACIN dịka ntuziaka ngwugwu si dị (mmiri ọgwụ a ga-abụ NAANỊ mmiri ọñụñụ ha maka ụbọchị 5-7). IHE DỊ MKPÀ: Nyochaa ma gwọọ Coccidiosis n'ihi na ọ na-emebi afọ ma na-akpata ntiwapụ nke Clostridium. Debe ihe ndina ha ka ọ kọọ. Ọgwụ ọdịnala: Enwere ike iji mmiri Onugbu ma ọ bụ Aloe Vera mezie afọ ha MGBE agwụchara ọgwụ a.
advice.pcm: Necrotic Enteritis bacterial decay inside intestine (Clostridium). Treat immediately with vet antibiotics: AMOXICILLIN, PENICILLIN, or BACITRACIN powder following exact packet label dosage (medicated water must be dia ONLY drinking water for 5-7 days). VERY IMPORTANT: Check and treat Coccidiosis too because cocci wound inside intestine na wetin dey make Clostridium bacteria attack. Keep bedding completely dry. Local remedy: Bitter leaf or aloe vera water fit help gut recover AFTER antibiotic treatment finishes.
advice.sw: Ugonjwa wa Kuoza kwa Utumbo (Necrotic Enteritis). Tibu mara moja kwa antibiotics za mifugo: AMOXICILLIN, PENICILLIN, au BACITRACIN kulingana na maelekezo ya pakiti (maji ya dawa yawe maji yao PEKEE kwa siku 5-7). MUHIMU: Chunguza na kutibu Coccidiosis pia, kwani michubuko ya cocci ndiyo inayosababisha bakteria hawa kushambulia. Weka matandiko makavu. Tiba ya kienyeji: Majani machungu au Aloe Vera husaidia kuponya utumbo BAADA ya kumaliza antibiotics.

names.sw: Homa ya Matumbo ya Kuku (Fowl Typhoid)

advice.en: 🚨 HIGH MORTALITY BACTERIAL INFECTION (Salmonella gallinarum). Isolate sick birds IMMEDIATELY. Treat the entire flock with veterinary antibiotics: ENROFLOXACIN, FLORFENICOL, or SULFA-TRIMETHOPRIM following exact packet label dosage (medicated water as their ONLY drinking water for 5-7 days). ⚠️ Safely incinerate or deep-bury dead birds to prevent environmental contamination. Test and cull breeding carriers. Local remedy: Probiotics or squeezed bitter leaf extract can be given to support gut recovery AFTER antibiotic treatment ends.
advice.ha: 🚨 CUTAR TYPHOID MAI ƘARFI (Salmonella gallinarum). Ware tsuntsaye marasa lafiya YANZU. Yi wa dukan garken magani da magungunan antibiotics: ENROFLOXACIN, FLORFENICOL, ko SULFA-TRIMETHOPRIM bisa ƙa'idar fakiti (ruwan magani ya zama KAWAI ruwan shansu na kwanaki 5-7). ⚠️ Ƙone ko binne matattun kaji sosai a cikin rami mai zurfi. Maganin gargajiya: Za a iya ba da ruwan Shuwaka don dawo da ƙarfin ciki BAYAN an gama maganin asibiti.
advice.yo: 🚨 ÀRÙN TYPHOID TÓ LÁGBÁRA (Salmonella gallinarum). Ya àwọn adìẹ aláìsàn sọ́tọ̀ LẸ́SẸ̀KẸSẸ̀. Tọ́jú gbogbo agbo adìẹ pẹ̀lú antibiotics: ENROFLOXACIN, FLORFENICOL, tàbí SULFA-TRIMETHOPRIM gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìlànà páálí (omi oògùn gbọ́dọ̀ jẹ́ OMI KANṢOṢO tí wọ́n ń mu fún ọjọ́ 5-7). ⚠️ Dáná sun tàbí sin àwọn adìẹ tó kú jinlẹ̀ sínú ilẹ̀. Oògùn ìbílẹ̀: Omi ewúrò lè ran ìfun lọ́wọ́ LẸ́YÌN tí o bá parí oògùn náà tán.
advice.ig: 🚨 ỌRỊA TYPHOID DỊ EGWU (Salmonella gallinarum). Kewapụ ọkụkọ na-arịa ọrịa OZIGBO. Jiri ọgwụ antibiotics gwọọ igwe ọkụkọ niile: ENROFLOXACIN, FLORFENICOL, ma ọ bụ SULFA-TRIMETHOPRIM dịka ntuziaka ngwugwu si dị (mmiri ọgwụ a ga-abụ NAANỊ mmiri ọñụñụ ha maka ụbọchị 5-7). ⚠️ Kpọọ ọkụ ma ọ bụ lie ọkụkọ nwụrụ anwụ nke ọma. Ọgwụ ọdịnala: Enwere ike iji mmiri Onugbu kwado afọ ha MGBE agwụchara ọgwụ a.
advice.pcm: 🚨 DANGEROUS TYPHOID BACTERIA (Salmonella gallinarum). Separate sick birds NOW NOW. Treat the whole flock with vet antibiotics: ENROFLOXACIN, FLORFENICOL, or SULFA-TRIMETHOPRIM following exact packet label dosage (medicated water must be dia ONLY drinking water for 5-7 days). ⚠️ Burn or bury dead birds deep inside ground. Local remedy: Bitter leaf extract fit support dia belly AFTER antibiotic medicine finishes.
advice.sw: 🚨 MAAMBUKIZI MAKALI YA TYPHOID YA KUKU (Salmonella gallinarum). Tenga ndege wagonjwa MARA MOJA. Tibu kundi zima kwa antibiotics za mifugo: ENROFLOXACIN, FLORFENICOL, au SULFA-TRIMETHOPRIM kulingana na maelekezo ya pakiti (maji ya dawa yawe maji yao PEKEE kwa siku 5-7). ⚠️ Choma au fukia mizoga ya kuku kwa kina kirefu. Tiba ya kienyeji: Majani machungu husaidia kurejesha afya ya utumbo BAADA ya kumaliza antibiotics.

advice.en: 🚨 HIGH MORTALITY IN YOUNG CHICKS (Salmonella pullorum - Bacillary White Diarrhea). Isolate affected chicks immediately and increase brooder temperature. Treat flock with veterinary antibiotics: ENROFLOXACIN, SULFAMETHAZINE, or OXYTETRACYCLINE strictly following packet label dosage based on concentration (medicated water as their ONLY drinking water for 5-7 days). Provide electrolytes and vitamins in water. Sanitize incubator and brooder thoroughly. Local remedy: Probiotics or mild garlic water for gut support AFTER medication ends.
advice.ha: 🚨 CUTAR FARIN ZAWO MAI KASHE YAN TSAKI (Pullorum). Ware ƴan tsakin da ke ciwo kuma ƙara ɗumin ɗaki. Yi wa garken magani da antibiotics: ENROFLOXACIN, SULFA, ko OXYTETRACYCLINE bisa ƙa'idar fakiti (ruwan magani ya zama KAWAI ruwan shansu na kwanaki 5-7). Ba da electrolytes da bitamin a ruwa. Tsaftace akwatin kyankyashewa. Maganin gargajiya: Ruwan tafarnuwa bayan an gama maganin asibiti.
advice.yo: 🚨 ÀRÙN ÌGBẸ́ FUNFUN TÓ Ń PA ỌMỌ ADÌẸ (Pullorum). Ya àwọn ọmọ adìẹ aláìsàn sọ́tọ̀ kí o sì mú kí ibùgbé gbóná. Tọ́jú wọn pẹ̀lú antibiotics: ENROFLOXACIN, SULFA, tàbí OXYTETRACYCLINE gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìlànà páálí (omi oògùn gbọ́dọ̀ jẹ́ OMI KANṢOṢO fún ọjọ́ 5-7). Fún wọn ní electrolytes àti vitamins. Oògùn ìbílẹ̀: Omi garlic pẹ̀lẹ́pẹ̀lẹ́ fún ìfun wọn LẸ́YÌN tí o bá parí oògùn náà tán.
advice.ig: 🚨 ỌRỊA NSỊ ỌCHA NA-EGBU ỤMỤ ỌKỤKỌ (Pullorum). Kewapụ ụmụ ọkụkọ na-arịa ya ma mee ka ụlọ ha kpoo ọkụ. Jiri antibiotics gwọọ ha: ENROFLOXACIN, SULFA, ma ọ bụ OXYTETRACYCLINE dịka ntuziaka ngwugwu si dị (mmiri ọgwụ a ga-abụ NAANỊ mmiri ọñụñụ ha maka ụbọchị 5-7). Nye electrolytes na vitamin. Ọgwụ ọdịnala: Mmiri garlic maka nkwado afọ MGBE agwụchara ọgwụ a.
advice.pcm: 🚨 DEADLY WHITE DIARRHEA IN CHICKS (Pullorum Disease). Separate sick chicks sharp sharp and make brooder warm. Treat with vet antibiotics: ENROFLOXACIN, SULFA, or OXYTETRACYCLINE following packet label dosage (medicated water must be dia ONLY drinking water for 5-7 days). Give electrolytes and vitamins. Wash and disinfect brooder well well. Local remedy: Mild garlic water fit support stomach AFTER finishing antibiotic treatment.
advice.sw: 🚨 MAAMBUKIZI MAKALI YA KUHARA CHEUPE KWA VIFARANGA (Pullorum). Tenga vifaranga wagonjwa mara moja na ongeza joto bandani. Tibu kundi kwa antibiotics: ENROFLOXACIN, SULFA, au OXYTETRACYCLINE kulingana na maelekezo ya pakiti (maji ya dawa yawe maji yao PEKEE kwa siku 5-7). Wape electrolytes na vitamini. Safisha vifaa vya kuangulia. Tiba ya kienyeji: Maji ya kitunguu saumu BAADA ya kumaliza dawa.

advice.en: Staphylococcal footpad infection (Bumblefoot). Treatment: Soak the affected foot in warm water mixed with Epsom salts for 10-15 minutes to soften the crust. Gently clean with povidone-iodine; if a hardened black necrotic plug is loose, remove it cleanly without damaging live tissue, pack with antibiotic wound ointment (or spray with oxytetracycline wound spray), and wrap securely with a clean bandage (change daily). Ensure coop perches are smooth, eliminate sharp wire mesh, and provide clean, dry litter.
advice.ha: Ciwon Ƙafar Kaji (Bumblefoot / Staph). Magani: Jiƙa ƙafar da ta kumbura a cikin ruwan ɗumi mai gishirin Epsom na minti 10-15 don ta yi laushi. Wanke da povidone-iodine; idan akwai baƙar ƙwaya mai wuya a cire ta a hankali, shafa maganin shafawa na antibiotic ko feshin oxytetracycline, sannan a ɗaure da bandeji mai tsafta (ana sauyawa a kullum). Gyara matattakalar kaji ta zama mai santsi kuma a busar da shimfida.
advice.yo: Àrùn Ẹsẹ̀ Wíwú (Bumblefoot). Ìtọ́jú: Rẹ ẹsẹ̀ náà sínú omi gbígbóná tó ní iyọ̀ Epsom fún ìṣẹ́jú 10-15 láti mú kí ó rọ̀. Fọ̀ ọ́ pẹ̀lú povidone-iodine; tí kókó dudu bá wà níbẹ̀, yọ ọ́ pẹ̀lẹ́pẹ̀lẹ́, fún un ní antibiotic ointment tàbí fọ́n oxytetracycline spray sí i, kí o sì fi aṣọ bandeji dì í (máa yí i padà lójoojúmọ́). Rí i dájú pé orí igi tí wọ́n ń bà lé dán dáadáa, kí ibùgbé wọn sì gbẹ.
advice.ig: Ọrịa Ụkwụ Fụrụ Akpụ (Bumblefoot). Ọgwụgwọ: Tinye ụkwụ ahụ n'ime mmiri ọkụ nwere nnu Epsom maka nkeji 10-15 iji mee ka ọ dị nro. Jiri povidone-iodine sachaa ya; wepụ akpụ ojii siri ike nwayọọ, tee ude ọgwụ antibiotic ma ọ bụ fesa oxytetracycline spray, wee kee ya na bandeeji dị ọcha (na-agbanwe ya kwa ụbọchị). Mee ka ebe ha na-azọ ụkwụ dị mma ma kọọ nkụ.
advice.pcm: Bumblefoot sore for bottom of leg (Staph infection). Treatment: Soak the sick foot inside warm water mixed with Epsom salt for 10-15 minutes make the skin soft. Clean with iodine disinfectant; gently remove the black hard plug if e soft, apply antibiotic wound ointment or spray oxytetracycline, then wrap with clean bandage (change am daily). Make sure perches/sticks are smooth and keep the floor dry and clean.
advice.sw: Maambukizi ya Kidonda cha Chini ya Mguu (Bumblefoot). Matibabu: Loweka mguu uliovimba kwenye maji ya uvuguvugu yenye chumvi ya Epsom kwa dakika 10-15 ili kulainisha. Safisha kwa povidone-iodine; ondoa kigaga cheusi kwa umakini, paka mafuta ya antibiotic au dawa ya kupuliza ya vidonda, kisha funga bandeji safi (badilisha kila siku). Hakikisha miti ya kutulia haina ukali na matandiko ni makavu.

names.sw: Kutetemeka kwa Kichwa na Shingo (Epidemic Tremor)

advice.en: Viral disease causing ataxia and head/neck tremors in young chicks. There is NO specific antiviral cure. Isolate affected chicks and provide easy floor-level access to feed and clean water supplemented with MULTIVITAMINS (rich in Vitamin E and B-complex) and ELECTROLYTES to support motor function. Humanely cull severely paralyzed chicks that cannot reach feed. Prevent in future flocks by VACCINATING breeder/layer pullets at 10-14 weeks of age before egg production begins.
advice.ha: Cutar Rawa da Shanyewar Kai (Avian Encephalomyelitis). Cutar virus ce da ba ta da maganin warkewa kai tsaye. Ware ƴan tsakin da ke fama da ciwon, a ajiye musu abinci da ruwa kusa a ƙasa mai ɗauke da MULTIVITAMINS (musamman Vitamin E da B-complex) da ELECTROLYTES. Kashe ƴan tsakin da suka shanye gaba ɗaya cikin aminci. Rigakafi a nan gaba: YI RIGAKAFI ga kaji a mako 10-14 kafin su fara yin ƙwai.
advice.yo: Àrùn Ríro Orí àti Ọrùn (Avian Encephalomyelitis). Àrùn fáírọ́ọ̀sì tí kò ní oògùn àwòtán tààràtà. Ya àwọn ọmọ adìẹ náà sọ́tọ̀ kí o sì fi oúnjẹ àti omi tí a da MULTIVITAMINS (pàápàá Vitamin E àti B-complex) àti ELECTROLYTES sí lẹ́gbẹ̀ẹ́ wọn lórí ilẹ̀. Yọ àwọn tí kò lè dìde kúrò. Dènà rẹ̀ ní ọjọ́ iwájú nípa ṢÍṢE AJESARA fún àwọn adìẹ ní ọ̀sẹ̀ 10-14 kí wọ́n tó bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí í yéyin.
advice.ig: Ọrịa Ịma Jijiji Isi na Olu (Avian Encephalomyelitis). Ọrịa virus na-enweghị ọgwụgwọ ozugbo. Kewapụ ụmụ ọkụkọ na-arịa ya ma dowe nri na mmiri dị nso n'ala nwere MULTIVITAMINS (karịsịa Vitamin E na B-complex) na ELECTROLYTES. Wepụ ụmụ ọkụkọ kpọnwụrụ akpọnwụ kpamkpam. Gbochie ya n'ọdịnihu site na ịgba ỌGWỤ MGBOCHI mgbe ha ruru izuụka 10-14 tupu ha amalite ịtọ akwa.
advice.pcm: Epidemic Tremor virus (Chicks head shaking and trembling). No direct antiviral medicine. Separate sick chicks and put feed and clean water on the ground close to them with MULTIVITAMINS (rich in Vitamin E and B-complex) plus ELECTROLYTES to support dia body. Cull chicks wey totally paralyze. Prevent for future by giving VACCINE to mother birds/pullets at 10-14 weeks before dem start laying eggs.
advice.sw: Ugonjwa wa Kutetemeka kwa Kichwa na Shingo (Avian Encephalomyelitis). Ugonjwa wa virusi usio na dawa ya moja kwa moja. Tenga vifaranga wagonjwa na uwawekee chakula na maji karibu sakafuni yakiwa na MULTIVITAMINS (hasa Vitamini E na B) pamoja na ELECTROLYTES. Waondoe vifaranga waliopooza kabisa. Zuia kwa siku zijazo kwa KUCHANJA kuku wiki ya 10-14 kabla ya kuanza kutaga.

Supplement feed or water with LIPOTROPIC NUTRIENTS: Choline Chloride, Inositol, Vitamin B12, Vitamin E, and Selenium to promote liver fat breakdown and strengthen liver blood vessels. Minimize heat stress and avoid overfeeding. Local remedy: Provide fresh chopped greens (moringa, spinach) to supply natural antioxidants and bioflavonoids.
advice.ha: Matsalar Ƙiba a Hanta (Fatty Liver Syndrome). Matsala ce ta abinci a cikin kajin ƙwai. Matakin gaggawa: Rage yawan masara ko abinci mai sukari/ƙiba, a ƙara sinadaran gina jiki (protein) da fiber. Ƙara sinadaran LIPOTROPIC a abinci ko ruwa: Choline Chloride, Inositol, Vitamin B12, Vitamin E, da Selenium don narke ƙiba a hanta. Rage zafin ɗaki. Fi àwọn èròjà wọ̀nyí sínú oúnjẹ tàbí omi wọn: Choline Chloride, Inositol, Vitamin B12, Vitamin E, àti Selenium láti yọ ọ̀rá kúrò nínú ẹ̀dọ̀. Dín ooru kù. Oògùn ìbílẹ̀: Fún wọn ní ewé Zogale tàbí ewé tútù fún ààbò ẹ̀dọ̀.
advice.ig: Ọrịa Abụba n'Ime Imeju (Fatty Liver Syndrome). Nsogbu sitere na nri na-edozi ahụ na nnekwu ọkụkọ na-atọ akwa. Ọgwụgwọ: Belata nri nwere oke ọka/abụba ma nye protein dị mma. Tinye ihe ndị a na nri ma ọ bụ mmiri ha: Choline Chloride, Inositol, Vitamin B12, Vitamin E, na Selenium iji gbari abụba n'imeju. Belata oke okpomọkụ. Ọgwụ ọdịnala: Nye akwụkwọ nri dị ka Zogale ma ọ bụ akwụkwọ ndụ akwụkwọ ndụ maka nchekwa imeju.
advice.pcm: Fatty Liver disease (Too much fat busting layer hen liver). Treatment: Reduce high-energy carbohydrate (corn/maize) and balance with good protein and fiber. Put LIPOTROPIC TONIC inside dia feed/water: Choline Chloride, Inositol, Vitamin B12, Vitamin E, and Selenium to melt liver fat and stop internal bleeding. Reduce heat inside coop. Local remedy: Chop fresh moringa or green vegetables into dia feed to give natural antioxidants.
advice.sw: Ugonjwa wa Mafuta Kwenye Ini (Fatty Liver Syndrome). Tatizo la lishe kwa kuku wanene wa mayai. Hatua: Punguza kiwango cha mahindi/wanga na ongeza protini bora na nyuzinyuzi. Ongeza virutubisho kwenye chakula au maji: Choline Chloride, Inositol, Vitamini B12, Vitamini E, na Selenium ili kuyeyusha mafuta kwenye ini. Punguza joto bandani. Tiba ya kienyeji: Wape majani mabichi ya mlonge au mboga za majani kulinda ini.

advice.en: 🚨 CRITICAL TOXICOSIS (Clostridium botulinum pre-formed toxin from decaying carcasses, maggots, or stagnant water). Immediate action: REMOVE all decaying matter, dead birds, maggots, and spoiled feed immediately. Flush the flock's digestive system with EPSOM SALTS (10-15g per 1 liter of drinking water for 1 day only) or activated charcoal to bind and purge ingested toxins. Follow up with fresh clean water and ELECTROLYTES with MULTIVITAMINS to support nerve recovery. No antibiotic will kill the pre-formed toxin.
advice.ha: 🚨 GUBAR BOTULISM / SANYIN WUYA (Daga matattun tsuntsaye da suka ruɓe, tsutsotsi, ko ruwa mai ɗoyi). Matakin gaggawa: CIRE duk wani mushe, tsuntsu da ya mutu, tsutsotsin mushe, ko ruɓaɓɓen abinci nan da nan. Wanke cikin kajin da GISHIRIN EPSOM (gram 10-15 a litar ruwa 1 na yini 1 kacal) ko garin gawayi (activated charcoal) don kora gubar. Bayan haka a ba su ruwa mai tsafta tare da ELECTROLYTES da MULTIVITAMINS. Antibiotics ba sa kashe gubar da ta riga ta shiga jiki.
advice.yo: 🚨 MÁLETI TÓ LÁGBÁRA / ỌRÙN RÍRO (Botulism láti ara adìẹ tó jẹrà, ìdin, tàbí omi tó dọ̀tí). Ìgbésẹ̀ pàjáwìrì: YỌ gbogbo ohun tó jẹrà, adìẹ tó kú, àti oúnjẹ tó bàjẹ́ kúrò lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀. Fọ ikùn gbogbo adìẹ pẹ̀lú IYỌ̀ EPSOM (gram 10-15 nínú lita omi kan fún ọjọ́ kan péré) tàbí ẹ̀dú (activated charcoal) láti lé máleti náà jáde. Lẹ́yìn náà, fún wọn ní omi mímọ́ tó ní ELECTROLYTES àti MULTIVITAMINS. Antibiotics kò lè pa máleti tó ti wọ̀ wọ́n lára.
advice.ig: 🚨 NSI BOTULISM / OLU NREKASỊ (Site n'anụ nwụrụ anwụ rere ure, ikpuru, ma ọ bụ mmiri rụrụ arụ). Ihe a ga-eme ozugbo: WEPỤ ihe niile rere ure, ọkụkọ nwụrụ anwụ na nri rụrụ arụ ozugbo. Jiri NNU EPSOM (gram 10-15 n'ime lita mmiri 1 maka otu ụbọchị) ma ọ bụ unyi charcoal sachapụ afọ ha iji wepụ nsí ahụ. Nyezie mmiri dị ọcha nwere ELECTROLYTES na MULTIVITAMINS. Antibiotics anaghị egbu nsí batara n'ahụ.
advice.pcm: 🚨 POISON FROM ROTTEN MEAT / DEAD BIRDS (Botulism Limberneck). Sharp action: PACK OUT all dead decaying birds, maggots, and spoiled feed immediately. Flush the birds belly with EPSOM SALT (10-15g inside 1 liter of water for 1 day only) or activated charcoal to suck out and purge the poison. After that, give fresh clean water with ELECTROLYTES and MULTIVITAMINS to revive dia nerves. Antibiotic no fit kill poison wey bird don already swallow.
advice.sw: 🚨 SUMU YA BOTULISM / KUSHINDWA KUNYANYUA SHINGO (Kutoka kwa mizoga iliyooza, funza, au maji machafu). Hatua ya haraka: ONDOA mizoga yote iliyooza, funza, na vyakula vilivyoharibika mara moja. Safisha mfumo wa mmeng'enyo kwa CHUMVI YA EPSOM (gramu 10-15 kwa lita 1 ya maji kwa siku 1 tu) au mkaa safi uliosagwa (activated charcoal) ili kutoa sumu mwilini. Kisha wape maji safi yenye ELECTROLYTES na MULTIVITAMINS. Dawa za antibiotics haziui sumu iliyokwisha ingia mwilini.

advice.en: Severe environmental heat stress (Panting, heat stroke). Immediate relief: provide COOL, FRESH drinking water continuously and add VITAMIN C (Ascorbic Acid) and ELECTROLYTES (stress pack) to restore acid-base balance. Withdraw feed during the hottest peak hours of the day (11 AM – 4 PM) because digestion generates metabolic heat; feed early morning and cool evening. Maximize cross-ventilation, wet roof tops or mist pens, and reduce bird density. Local remedy: Add fresh mint leaf extract or cucumber slices in cool water for natural soothing.
advice.ha: Matsanancin Zafin Rana (Heat Stress). Sauƙi na gaggawa: ba da RUWA MAI SANYI da tsafta akai-akai kuma a ƙara VITAMIN C da ELECTROLYTES a ruwan sha don daidaita gishirin jiki. KADA a ba su abinci a lokacin da rana ta fi zafi (ƙarfe 11 na safe zuwa 4 na yamma) domin narkar da abinci yana ƙara zafin jiki; a ciyar da safe da yamma. Bude tagogi don samun iska kuma a fesa ruwa a kan rufin ɗaki. Maganin gargajiya: Za a iya zuba yankakken cucumber ko ganyen mint a cikin ruwan sanyi.
advice.yo: Ìfúnpá Ooru Gbígbóná (Heat Stress). Ìtura lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀: pèsè OMI TÚTÙ tí ó mọ́ nígbà gbogbo kí o sì fi VITAMIN C àti ELECTROLYTES sí i láti dọ́gba iyọ̀ inú ara wọn. MÁ ṢE fún wọn ní oúnjẹ lásìkò tí oòrùn bá gbóná jùlọ (11 AM sí 4 PM) nítorí jíjẹ oúnjẹ ń mú kí ara gbóná sí i; fún wọn ní oúnjẹ ní àárọ̀ kùtùkùtù àti ìrọ̀lẹ́ tútù. Ṣí gbogbo fèrèsé kí afẹ́fẹ́ wọlé dáadáa. Oògùn ìbílẹ̀: Fi cucumber tàbí ewé mint sínú omi tútù fún ìtura àdánidá.
advice.ig: Oke Okpomọkụ (Heat Stress). Enyemaka ozugbo: nye MMIRI OYI dị ọcha mgbe niile ma tinye VITAMIN C na ELECTROLYTES iji dozie nnu n'ahụ ha. ENYELA nri n'oge anwụ kacha chaa (11 AM ruo 4 PM) n'ihi na mgbaze nri na-eme ka ahụ dịkwuo ọkụ; na-enye nri n'ụtụtụ na mgbede. Mepee windo niile maka ikuku dị mma. Ọgwụ ọdịnala: Tinye cucumber ma ọ bụ akwụkwọ mint na mmiri oyi maka nkwado.
advice.pcm: Serious Heat Stress (Birds dey pant and open wings). Sharp relief: Give COOL CLEAN drinking water nonstop and mix VITAMIN C and ELECTROLYTES (stress pack) inside to cool dia body down. NO FEED BIRDS during hot afternoon (11 AM - 4 PM) because digesting food dey produce extra body heat; feed early morning and cool evening. Open windows wide for plenty breeze and spray water on roof. Local remedy: Put cucumber slices or mint leaves inside cool drinking water for natural cooling.
advice.sw: Athari ya Joto Kali (Heat Stress). Msaada wa haraka: Wape MAJI BARIDI na safi ya kunywa mara kwa mara na weka VITAMINI C na ELECTROLYTES kwenye maji kusawazisha chumvichumvi mwilini. USIWAPE chakula wakati wa jua kali (saa 5 asubuhi hadi saa 10 jioni) kwa sababu kusaga chakula huongeza joto mwilini; lisha asubuhi na jioni. Fungua madirisha kwa hewa ya kutosha na nyunyizia maji juu ya paa. Tiba ya kienyeji: Weka vipande vya tango au majani ya mnanaa kwenye maji baridi.

advice.ha: Ciwon Numfashi na CRD. Yi magani da antibiotics: TYLOSIN, ERYTHROMYCIN, ko DOXYCYCLINE bisa ƙa'idar fakiti (ruwan magani ya zama KAWAI ruwan shansu na kwanaki 5-7). advice.yo: Àrùn CRD Ikọ́ Ẹ̀dọ̀fóró. Tọ́jú rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú antibiotics: TYLOSIN, ERYTHROMYCIN, tàbí DOXYCYCLINE gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìlànà páálí (omi oògùn náà gbọ́dọ̀ jẹ́ OMI KANṢOṢO fún ọjọ́ 5-7). advice.ig: Ọrịa Ume CRD. Jiri antibiotics gwọọ ya: TYLOSIN, ERYTHROMYCIN, ma ọ bụ DOXYCYCLINE dịka ntuziaka ngwugwu si dị (mmiri ọgwụ a ga-abụ NAANỊ mmiri ọñụñụ ha maka ụbọchị 5-7). advice.sw: Ugonjwa wa Kupumua wa CRD. Tibu kwa antibiotics: TYLOSIN, ERYTHROMYCIN, au DOXYCYCLINE kulingana na maelekezo ya pakiti (maji ya dawa yawe maji yao PEKEE kwa siku 5-7).
